Hostile host page

A deliberately uncooperative page. Behaviour is the content here.

Safe region

Clicks inside this element are left alone. Everywhere else they are stopped in the capture phase.

No events recorded.

Ordinary region

Clicks here are swallowed before they can bubble anywhere useful.

Wheel-locked region

Wheel events over this panel are cancelled with a non-passive listener, so it cannot be scrolled with a trackpad or mouse wheel.

Keyboard scrolling and dragging the scrollbar still work, which is what makes this awkward rather than simply broken.

An injected popover rendered on top of this area inherits the same problem, because the listener is bound on document and fires regardless of target depth.

Filler line so the region genuinely overflows its fixed height.

Another filler line for the same reason.

Host action

Host modal

Sits at z-index 900 and takes the whole viewport, so anything injected below that value becomes unreachable while it is open.
